column1: # ONE PIECE CHARACTER GENERATOR — RACES DATABASE
# race = race name (a Hybrid name is in hybrids.csv)
# weight = relative probability (0 = never rolled as a pure race, but can be a hybrid component)
# doriki_min / doriki_max = Doriki range given in the 1st Year
# bounty_min / bounty_max = racial bounty range (0 = none). Hybrids inherit 50% of each component
# kind = Biological / Artificial (mechanical component, only inside hybrids) / Category (the row Hybrid rolls a hybrid from hybrids.csv)
# A hybrid has no row here: its Doriki and bounty are the average of its two components (see hybrids.csv).
# Machine is only a component (weight 0). Its Doriki (19 to 590) makes Human + Machine = Cyborg keep the old Cyborg range (10 to 300)
# Weight 4 = the old Hybrid (3) + the old Cyborg (1), so the share of hybrids does not change
